title: pricing-research-report template variables
description: Values for templates/pricing-research-report.md.j2 and templates/pricing-research-report.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from pricing-research-report.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

annual_discount.title: Annual discount
annual_discount.description: Annual discount as a percentage, and say what it costs you in months free. It is the lever people set by feel; write the number so the margin impact is visible in the same document.

interview_n.title: Interview n
interview_n.description: How many pricing interviews back the quotes below. Two enthusiastic quotes from a sample of two is the most common way a pricing report talks a team into the wrong number.

model_notes.title: Model notes
model_notes.description: The model notes used under 'Competitor Analysis'.

pricing_model.title: Pricing model
pricing_model.description: The model recommended. Choose on how the buyer's value scales, not on billing convenience - usage-based on a metric the buyer cannot forecast is churn designed in from day one.

product_name.description: The product being priced, as customers name it. One product per report - two in one document means the cheaper one quietly subsidises the other and nobody notices for a year.

value_calculation.title: Value calculation
value_calculation.description: The arithmetic behind the value claim - hours saved times their hourly rate, or the named tool this replaces and its price. Show the working; a value number without it is a wish.

van_westendorp_n.title: Van westendorp n
van_westendorp_n.description: How many people answered the four price questions. Below 30 the thresholds are anecdotes drawn as a chart - state the real number so the reader can discount them properly.

x_y_month.title: X y month
x_y_month.description: Target capture (10-20% of delivered value). From section 'Value Analysis'.
